Your Gateway to Nature’s Serenity
Nestled on the peaceful Bogie River, Normanby Rd Nature Bush Camp offers affordable, authentic bush camping. Located between Bowen and Collinsville in North Queensland’s Whitsunday Region, our family-owned bush camp invites you to relax, explore, and reconnect with nature.
Come and unwind or host your next event, large or small. Give us a call!
What We Offer
We are dedicated to providing an exceptional experience for all our guests. Our services are designed to ensure comfort, convenience, and enjoyment during your stay.
Spacious, Shaded Campsites: Enjoy generously sized, level campsites with scenic views of the Bogie River, accommodating caravans, camper trailers, buses, tents and swags.
Campers’ Kitchen: Make use of our kitchen and BBQ facilities, perfect for cooking and socialising.
Kids’ Games and Activities: Keep the children entertained with a range of games, including Giant Jenga with more to come.
Wheelchair Accessible bush Showers: Our large, accessible showers are designed to accommodate all guests comfortably.
Host your next event: Enquire about hosting your next event, large or small. Need catering? Enquire for more information.
Wood-Fired Pizza Oven: Enjoy special occasions and local charity fundraisers with delicious pizzas from our Wood-fired Pizza Oven.
Our fees - $20 per site per night, maximum 5 persons per site. (one caravan & one vehicle) Events priced separately.
*Enquire about current discounts and promotional offers.
Camping in the Whitsundays region
Whether you’re keen to explore along the Bogie River, discover the beauty of the surrounding bushland, or take a short trip to neighbouring Collinsville or Bowen, we provide the perfect base for your adventure. Reconnect with nature and unwind, or thinking about hosting your next event or special occasion? Get in touch with our team for more information.

Our Passion for Camping
At Normanby Rd Nature Bush Camp, we have a love of all thing camping. Established in July 2024, our camp is nestled on 22 acres of bushland along the Bogie River, between Bowen and Collinsville. Operated by Paul, Tori and family, we offer affordable, family-friendly camping with well-kept facilities, ensuring a peaceful escape in North Queensland’s Whitsunday Region.
What Sets Us Apart
As a family of avid campers, we understand what makes a camping trip enjoyable and stress-free. We offer what we value - affordability, child-friendly activities, shady spots, campfires (weather permitting), a camp kitchen, clean showers, and we are pet-friendly.
Secure Your Campsite Today
Don’t miss out on your chance to experience the beauty and tranquillity of Normanby Rd Nature Bush Camp. Reserve your spot now and enjoy spacious, shady campsites by the Bogie River.
